name: Shen Ch'uan-ch'i
bio: Shen Ch'uan-ch'i was a T'ang poet who took his degree at the government examinations about AD 680 and died about AD 713. His two poems here concern wives left waiting while their husbands serve on the frontier.
The poems here are Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu's versions in The Jade Mountain (1929), given with the poet's name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: Lines
poems.author: Shen Ch'uan-ch'i
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
Against the City of the Yellow Dragon
Our troops were sent long years ago,
And girls here watch the same melancholy moon
That lights our Chinese warriors —
And young wives dream a dream of spring,
That last night their heroic husbands,
In a great attack, with flags and drums,
Captured the City of the Yellow Dragon.

poems.title: Beyond Seeing
poems.author: Shen Ch'uan-ch'i
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
A girl of the Lu clan who lives in Golden-Wood Hall,
Where swallows perch in pairs on beams of tortoise-shell,
Hears the washing-mallets' cold beat shake the leaves down.
. . . The Liao-yang expedition will be gone ten years,
And messages are lost in the White Wolf River.
. . . Here in the City of the Red Phoenix autumn nights are long,
Where one who is heart-sick to see beyond seeing,
Sees only moonlight on the yellow-silk wave of her loom.

poems.title: 侍宴 (Shi yan)
poems.author: Shen Ch'uan-ch'i
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
皇家貴主好神仙，別業初開雲漢邊。
山出盡如鳴鳳嶺，池成不讓飲龍川。
妝樓翠幌教春住，舞閣金鋪借日懸。
敬從乘輿來此地，稱觴獻壽樂鈞天。

poems.title: 雜詩三首·其三 (Za shi san shou, qi san)
poems.author: Shen Ch'uan-ch'i
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
聞道黃龍戍，頻年不解兵。
可憐閨裏月，長在漢家營。
少婦今春意，良人昨夜情。
誰能將旗鼓，一爲取龍城。

poems.title: 古意呈補闕喬知之 (Gu yi cheng bu que qiao zhi zhi)
poems.author: Shen Ch'uan-ch'i
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.note: 樂府. Also titled 獨不見.
poems.text:
盧家少婦鬱金堂，海燕雙棲玳瑁梁。
九月寒砧催木葉，十年征戍憶遼陽。
白狼河北音書斷，丹鳳城南秋夜長。
誰謂含愁獨不見，更教明月照流黃。
